items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: I got a chance to record with Elvin Jones... he wasn’t even leading the thing it was like he was a side person like myself... so we started talking... he was on it, this singer Roseanna Vitro

ctx.x: Wow. 60 years. You’ve played with a lot of other pop artists we’ll call it. If you have Spotify on or Sirius radio things come on the radio and you go, “I think I was on that.” Does that happen to you?

It has, where I’ll be like, “Oh yeah I forgot about doing that.” It has happened where like I think that — is that even me? You know like it could be me. Because I did a lot of recordings in New York with different acts and different performers and artists and stuff. And I often remember most things but then yeah, something slips. Yeah I did that or even — but it’s kind of a cool thing to have the experience of performing with so many people over the years and, you know, being influenced by their music and then…
Would that have been like I remember having albums with him and Joe Farrell — two tenors?
